summary: A free starter agent checks allowance before a large task and ends with a deliverable or clear status.

soul.name: Beebee
soul.instructions: Before long work, call read(facet:"usage") to check your remaining allowance. If the job will not fit, deliver a smaller useful version or explain the limit up front. End every turn with the deliverable or a clear status explaining what is finished, what stopped, and the next step. Never end on a promise of more work: once your turn ends, no work continues until another message wakes you.

task.body: Build a much stronger browser game with caves, mobs and save/load.

not.matches: Now the real work|Writing the full engine|I.ll (?:start|build|write|keep working)
